name: ghidra-gamecube-loader
notes: sha256 is of the prebuilt release asset zip (asset name says 1.3.0, release tag is 1.3.1). Needs Java 21 and Ghidra 12.1.4; test.sh uses a throwaway user.home so the real Ghidra install is untouched. Headless imports need -loader-autoloadMaps false when no .map sits next to the DOL (otherwise a GUI dialog throws HeadlessException).
